decisions.openspec_verify_archive_gap_2026-07-07: Discovered while applying change 4 (first-party-direct-dep-hygiene): `openspec validate`/`openspec archive` hard-require at least one delta spec (specs/<capability>/spec.md with ADDED/MODIFIED Requirements + Scenario blocks), but changes 1-3 all declared 'Capabilities: None' since they're pure disclosure/mitigation fixes with no UAR-observable behavior change -- this repeats a gap already flagged in uar-spec-v2-and-polish's reflection ('none of the 7 OpenSpec changes were run through /opsx:verify + /opsx:archive'). User chose (AskUserQuestion): add a minimal delta spec per change rather than skip verify/archive or switch schemas. Introduced a new `dependency-security-posture` capability (openspec/specs/dependency-security-posture/spec.md) with one ADDED Requirement per change, retrofitted into changes 1-3's proposal.md Capabilities sections, then verified+archived all 4 changes in chronological order (openspec archive requires -y/--yes flag to avoid an interactive prompt that force-closes non-interactively). All 4 are now archived under openspec/changes/archive/2026-07-07-<name>/. REMAINING 5 CHANGES IN THIS PHASE MUST FOLLOW THE SAME PATTERN: add a dependency-security-posture delta (new Requirement, ADDED, with SHALL/MUST on the requirement's own text -- keep the lead sentence on ONE unwrapped line, the openspec parser only reads the requirement's first line for SHALL/MUST) to each change's proposal.md + specs/ before running verify/archive.
